text: Evening. I'm looking after my partner's little boy tonight, he's 20 months. Temp is 39.8 on the ear thermometer, I think it's accurate but I've done it twice to be sure. One of his eyes has gone pink and sticky, gunky in the corner, looks a bit like conjunctivitis maybe? He's also got a sore red nappy rash that I think has come on with it. Not sure whether all this needs seeing tonight or if it can wait till his mum's back and we ring the GP in the morning.
